FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (PB-POOL-128, agent 128) — growth-project-mobile#513 @ 3cc982576143ed32a318f72d9835f5e6b3bf6291 — READY FOR AUDIT

Option A per owner decision 14:39 (playbook learning keeps debiting the head coach's AI pool). Copy-only: the AI credits walkthrough card 1 (both variants) says Roman learning the coaching method uses a few cents per refresh, at most four times a day. CI green at this head (Typecheck, lint, test; CodeQL), mergeable clean, 30 changed lines. No backend PR: trust-pages.html.ts does not list what uses AI credits.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 (LN-OPUS-B-128) — growth-project-mobile#513 @ 3cc982576143ed32a318f72d9835f5e6b3bf6291 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Full review (PB-POOL-A, T3 money copy). 30 changed lines (+28 / -2) in 2 files. CI and CodeQL are green at this head. The handlers and routes are unchanged (Continue, the packs, I'll buy later, Done), and the new line is the right idea under option A. Its frequency cap, however, is not what the backend does.

B1: the "at most four times a day" claim is false on deploy days.
- User story: a head coach whose clients add notes every day keeps the playbook sources changing. On a day the backend restarts or deploys a few times, Roman's learning builds and debits the coach's credits more than four times, even though the walkthrough promised "at most four times a day".
- Where: src/components/coach/ai-budget/AIBudgetTutorialModal.tsx:82-83 (`ROMAN_LEARNING_LINE`). The backend on main has no per-coach minimum interval:
  - src/roman/playbook/playbook-builder.scheduler.ts:22-27 runs `tick()` 3 minutes after every boot.
  - :36 also runs it on `@Cron('0 */6 * * *')`.
  - The only guard against rebuilding is the source digest (playbook-builder.service.ts:159, `unchanged`), so a boot run after any source change builds and reserves spend again (:170-176).
  - Backend main merged 75 PRs on 10-06, so restarts are routine, not an edge case.
- Smallest fix (copy only): drop the cap, for example: "When Roman learns your coaching method, each refresh uses a few cents of credit. Refreshes run a few times a day, only when something new was added." The alternative is a backend guard that skips a coach whose active `built_at` is under 6 hours old (T4 backend, which is larger). Whichever is chosen, update the test assertion with it.

Cs:
- C: "a few cents" is plausible for one Sonnet call at 4,096 maximum output tokens, but it is not pinned anywhere. Consider tying it to the per-build ceiling in the spend admission, if one exists, before FEATURE_ROMAN_PLAYBOOK (currently unset) is turned on.
- C: in a team, the debit goes to the head coach's pool (`payer: head`). A non-head coach reading "uses … credit" may not know which pool pays. That is acceptable for now.

FIX ROUND 2 (PB-POOL-128, agent 128, FIX-RC-128) — growth-project-mobile#513 @ 79e0760d90c7a3cebee3728d4c7e94113498f8d7 — READY FOR AUDIT

Fixed (LN-OPUS-B-128 REQUEST CHANGES @ 3cc98257):
- B1 ("at most four times a day" false on deploy days): src/components/coach/ai-budget/AIBudgetTutorialModal.tsx:83 now reads "When Roman learns your coaching method, each refresh uses a few cents of credit. Refreshes run a few times a day, only when something new was added." No hard maximum; "only when something new was added" matches the backend source-digest guard (playbook-builder.service.ts `unchanged`). Both card-1 variants. Test src/components/coach/ai-budget/__tests__/AIBudgetTutorialModal.test.tsx asserts the new line and that no "at most" claim remains (fails on the old copy by construction).

Nothing else changed. origin/main merged, no conflict. 33 changed lines. Local targeted jest 6/6; CI green at this head (Typecheck, lint, test; CodeQL).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 (LN-OPUS-B-128) — growth-project-mobile#513 @ 79e0760d90c7a3cebee3728d4c7e94113498f8d7 — VERDICT: APPROVE

Delta re-review, 3cc98257..79e0760d (FIX ROUND 2). Against the merge base with main, the PR is still 2 files with +31 / -2 lines.

Previous B1 ("at most four times a day" was false on deploy days): FIXED. AIBudgetTutorialModal.tsx:83 now reads "…each refresh uses a few cents of credit. Refreshes run a few times a day, only when something new was added." There is no hard maximum any more. "Only when something new was added" matches the backend source-digest skip (playbook-builder.service.ts:159 `unchanged`), and "a few times a day" matches the 6-hour cron plus boot runs. Both card-1 variants use the shared constant, and the test asserts the new line and that no "at most" remains. The handlers are unchanged, and CI and CodeQL are green.

Bs: none.

Cs: my two earlier Cs still apply ("a few cents" is unpinned, and the head-coach pool is not named). Neither blocks.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol (LN-SOL-B3-129) — growth-project-mobile#513 @ 79e0760d90c7a3cebee3728d4c7e94113498f8d7 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

B-513-SOL-129-1: A coach archives an existing template without adding anything, and Roman can still spend credits on a refresh although the tutorial promises refreshes run “only when something new was added.” The changed claim is at [AIBudgetTutorialModal.tsx:83](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/79e0760d90c7a3cebee3728d4c7e94113498f8d7/src/components/coach/ai-budget/AIBudgetTutorialModal.tsx#L81-L98).

Proof: the collector excludes archived templates/plans, so archiving changes the source-ID ledger without any addition; the builder skips only an equal digest and otherwise reserves and settles the coach-pool spend. ([collector](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c3324d4a24a9b211199b994b312ffc6b44b964a8/src/roman/playbook/playbook-sources.ts#L152-L185), [builder](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c3324d4a24a9b211199b994b312ffc6b44b964a8/src/roman/playbook/playbook-builder.service.ts#L149-L197))

Smallest fix: delete the unsupported “only when something new was added” qualifier, or describe source changes rather than additions; update both-mode copy assertions. Keep the credit-spending disclosure. No backend/billing change requested.

Scope: 33-line copy/test diff, both purchase-visibility variants, scheduled builder/digest and coach-pool path; independent review, no current-head Opus verdict body read. CI checked at this head; local Jest not run while shared mobile deps were not READY.

U=0. C=0.

agent 129
